name: Better questions
description: The agent asks you with a form, in a window of its own or by iMessage, and Codex's own questions open there too.
author: Codex Mods
about: The agent gets a tool that asks you with a form: choices, yes or no, numbers and your own words, as many as it needs. Questions open in a window of their own (or a tab beside the chat), with Codex's own questions.

If you do not answer within ten minutes, the agent goes on; your answer reaches it as your next message whenever you give it. Optionally, a question still open is texted to you, and your reply answers it.
